name: Muthoot Finance Ltd
description: Muthoot Finance Ltd is India's largest gold financing company (NBFC) and a systemic leader in household jewelry-backed credit. company_profile.summary: Muthoot Finance Ltd is India's largest gold financing company (NBFC) and a systemic leader in household jewelry-backed credit. With a rich heritage of over 800 years rooted in Kerala, the flagship enterprise operates over 4,800 branches nationwide, holding over 185 tonnes of gold jewelry in high-security vaults as collateral for retail loans.

revenue_breakup.desc: Short-term retail and small business credit secured against household gold jewelry collateral.
Unsecured microfinance loans disbursed to women self-help groups in semi-urban India.
Affordable housing mortgages (Homefin) and commercial vehicle / two-wheeler loans.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% across North India (40%), South India (38%), West (15%), and East (7%)
moats_and_strengths: Dominant market share (>50% of organized gold NBFC lending) holding over 185 tonnes of gold collateral.
Widespread physical distribution network of 4,800+ branches deeply trusted in local Indian communities.
Extremely low credit cost (<0.5%) as loans are backed by physical liquid gold collateral with low LTVs (<75%).
High return profile with Return on Assets (ROA > 4.5%) and Return on Equity (ROE ~ 19%).
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Gold Loan AUM: ₹75,000 Cr+ • Gold Collateral in Custody: 185+ Tonnes • 4,800+ Branches

promoter_governance.parent_group: M. G. George Muthoot Family (Founder Promoters hold ~73.4%)

bullish_triggers: Rising global and domestic spot gold prices automatically expanding borrowing headroom and loan asset values.
Surge in MSME working capital demand driving quick-disbursal gold loan originations.
Branch network expansion in under-penetrated northern and western Indian states.
bearish_risks: Sharp decline in gold bullion prices triggering margin calls and auction requirements.
Regulatory tightening by RBI regarding cash loan disbursement caps and loan-to-value (LTV) limits.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
